description: Use when the question is only whether a passport holder needs a visa for Vietnam on a given arrival date. Returns status (visa_exempt, outside_validity_window, not_exempt_for_this_purpose, not_in_exemption_list), maximum stay in days, the legal basis, the validity window (many unilateral exemptions end in 2028), a tourism-only flag, the source and the official e-visa domains. For a whole itinerary use check_vietnam_trip instead.

nationality.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code (e.g. DE) or English country name

name: check_entry

error.description: Present only when the input was invalid

title: Vietnam visa exemption check
